findings.description: The code calls contractVBit.read() and blindly trusts the result, discarding any I2C/BusIO failure.
i2c_dev is used without verifying it is initialized. If null, the call chain can dereference a null pointer.
The comment says “2nd bit” but the code uses bit index 2 (which is the third bit if zero-based).
Not validating the bit position against the register width can lead to reading out-of-range bits if constants change or are misconfigured.
